# pulse_kv_bucket (Resource)

A JetStream key-value bucket, for shared state such as tool configuration or the latest value of something. Clients read and write it with the NATS KV API (their grants must allow its `$KV.<bucket>.>` subjects). Deleting the resource deletes the bucket and every key. Import with the bucket name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Shared settings for home-automation tools, with the last 5 revisions of every key.
resource "pulse_kv_bucket" "settings" {
  name        = "home-settings"
  description = "Settings read by the home bots"
  history     = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Bucket name: letters, digits, `_` and `-`, at most 64. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `history` (Number) Revisions kept per key (1-64, default 1).
- `max_bytes` (Number) Size limit in bytes; `-1` (the default) is unlimited.
- `ttl_seconds` (Number) How long values are kept, in seconds; `0` (the default) keeps them forever.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Bucket name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pulse_kv_bucket.settings home-settings
```
